name: Allow NotAction with a Condition (boundary)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: NOTACTION-ALLOW Condition cell. Allow NotAction ['s3:GetObject'] on a scoped resource with a region Condition. NOTACTION-ALLOW still fires (Allow-NotAction grants everything except the listed actions; a Condition narrows when/where, it does not remove the inverted grant). Scoped Resource keeps WILDCARD-RESOURCE from firing so the rule-catalog output is exactly NOTACTION-ALLOW.
